title: Hover-1 Journey Folding Electric Scooter 15 MPH (White, H1-JNY-WHT)
writeup: The white Hover-1 Journey folding electric scooter (model H1-JNY-WHT) is $129.99 new on Woot Sport with only one left and a three-per-customer limit. Shopabunda lists the same new white Journey in stock at $390.17, which puts this about 66 percent below a live non-Amazon retail price. It has a 300W motor and a claimed range up to about 16 miles per charge, and the Woot offer is a clear steal versus that verified comparison.
